title: Plane Helicopter Hop
hook: Name the family before the flight sound.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D civilian aviation storybook, toy aircraft and ground gear, clean sky scenes; visual identity: Plane Helicopter Hop

creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: family-neutral recall -> target -> safe air gesture
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Plane Helicopter Hop a compare-and-contrast song: fixed wings, rotors, propellers, turboprops, drones, seaplanes and ultralights are distinguished by lift/propulsion and operating environment; hop stays musical, not a stunt cue.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child compares aircraft families side by side instead of calling every rotorcraft a plane or every propeller aircraft a turboprop.
